layouts.name: CRegionShape_RegionData
layouts.notes: 17763.719 and 18362.329: GetWindowClipShape initializes the FastRegion data pointer to the inline region header. BuildFromRects independently clears the DWORD reached through that pointer; the destructor passes the same FastRegion subobject to FreeMemory.

layouts.name: CRegionShape_InlineRegion
layouts.notes: 17763.719 and 18362.329: GetWindowClipShape initializes this inline header to zero and points RegionData at it before BuildFromRects. CShape::CopyShape independently initializes the same header in a zeroed 96-byte allocation.
